limitations: No browser route playthrough or real-device benchmark
No fresh full animation pose sampling or engine clip export
Godot checks are limited headless checks of external temporary copies; warnings retained in RUNTIME_CHECKS.txt
All production content remains outside the GitHub repository until assigned source intake

git_whitespace.preserved_reference_exceptions: Eight source Markdown hard-break lines (lines 3/4 in each of the four unchanged design copies); byte preservation takes precedence.

reproduction.html_syntax: Extract inline <script> content from B1 to a temporary .js file, then node --check <file>.
reproduction.godot_import: Godot 4.6.2 --headless --editor --path <temporary copy of G0 or extracted G3> --quit
reproduction.preservation: Resolve PROJECT_INVENTORY source_roots; compare sha256_before_setup for baseline_input records except the explicitly updated repo/AGENTS.md. Compare docs source copies with their originals.
